lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The tag. One name. Not a stranger. Not a teacher. 'JOY.' The most loyal kid in school… walked into the staff room at 2 a.m.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: No. NO. Bro, say something. Tell me you were sleepwalking. Tell me ANYTHING.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I did it. I took the paper. But you don't know WHY. Nobody ever asked why.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Three weeks ago I heard them in the office. The board wants to fail HALF the class. Re-exam fees. Charged TWICE. Our parents… they can't pay that.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: A conspiracy ABOVE the principal?! I have told six versions of this story and ALL of them were too small!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: No paper… no mass fail. No mass fail… no fees. I didn't steal answers. I stole the weapon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Silence. The kind of silence that happens when a school realizes… the thief was protecting them.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That plan was NEVER mine. The board proposed it. And tonight… the board answers to ME.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Then someone explain the impossible. The tag on the spare key… is written in MY handwriting. And I never wrote it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And there it was. The twist inside the twist. Kamal heard the board's plan too. Kamal couldn't be seen helping. So Kamal… left the key where a loyal kid would find it.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: New exam. Written in the open, where everyone can see it. And Joy — your detention starts… after the fair exam.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for the next story — because if a KEY can hide a hero… imagine what a report card hides.
